note: 文言六维品藻（0–100）。后效＝客观遗产；月旦＝褒贬≠知名度。非正式史评。

axes.label: 国祚
axes.desc: 在位久暂与身后政权是否立得住

axes.label: 后效
axes.desc: 客观上留给后代的路径/制度

axes.label: 月旦
axes.desc: 世人与史评总体褒贬（高正低负）

qin-shi-huang.cry: 六合之内，皇帝之号始定。
qin-shi-huang.cry_en: Within the Six Directions, the title of Emperor is set for the first time.
qin-shi-huang.ability_en: Unified the six states; founded the commandery system.
qin-shi-huang.weakness_en: Harsh laws; dead in a generation.

han-wu-di.cry_en: Whoever offends mighty Han shall be punished, however distant.
han-wu-di.ability_en: Drove the Xiongnu north; exalted Confucianism alone.
han-wu-di.weakness_en: War without end; the witchcraft terror.

tang-tai-zong.cry_en: With Wei Zheng as my mirror, I know what was gained and lost.
tang-tai-zong.ability_en: Took remonstrance with an open heart; the four tribes came as guests.
tang-tai-zong.weakness_en: Blood at Xuanwu Gate; nothing gained in Liaodong.

sui-yang.stand_name_en: The Prince of Jin at Jiangdong
sui-yang.cry_en: The canal still runs; the brocade sails never return.
sui-yang.ability_en: Dug the canal to link the realm; opened exams to choose the talented.
sui-yang.weakness_en: Extravagance without limit; death for himself and his dynasty.

n-tang-houzhu.cry_en: In the bright moonlight, I cannot bear to look back on my lost kingdom.
n-tang-houzhu.ability_en: Opened new realms in the ci lyric; plain-sketch verse beyond compare.
n-tang-houzhu.weakness_en: State affairs wholly neglected; the Qianji poison did its work.

han-xuan-di.cry: 汉家自有制度，本以霸王道杂之。
han-xuan-di.cry_en: The House of Han has its own institutions — the ways of King and Hegemon, blended.
han-xuan-di.ability_en: Weighed names against deeds; restored the House of Han.
han-xuan-di.weakness_en: The Huo clan's shadow; an heir too soft.

xin-wang-mang.cry_en: Even the Duke of Zhou had days of dreading rumor.
xin-wang-mang.ability_en: King's-land to curb the estates; the Five Equalizations to aid the people.
xin-wang-mang.weakness_en: Names divorced from deeds; reform on reform till collapse.

e-han-guangwu.cry: 仕宦当作执金吾，娶妻当得阴丽华。
e-han-guangwu.cry_en: In office, be the Bearer of the Golden Mace; in marriage, win Yin Lihua.
e-han-guangwu.ability_en: A bamboo-split victory at Kunyang; the soft way that settled the realm.
e-han-guangwu.weakness_en: Land surveys vexed the people; prophecy muddled policy.

h-zhao-shi-le.cry: 大丈夫行事当礌礌落落，如日月皎然。
h-zhao-shi-le.cry_en: A true man acts in the open, towering and bright as sun and moon.
h-zhao-shi-le.ability_en: Decisive victory in the open field; order from the army's tent.
h-zhao-shi-le.weakness_en: Shi Hu cursed his heirs; the state died with the tyrant.

liang-wu.cry: 自我得之，自我失之，亦复何恨。
liang-wu.cry_en: I won it myself, I lost it myself — what is there to regret?
liang-wu.ability_en: Long years of civil rule; the Buddhist faith raised high.
liang-wu.weakness_en: Took in Hou Jing to his ruin; the starved of Tai City.

xixia-li-yuanhao.cry_en: Tangut and Han stand side by side — a realm of our own.
xixia-li-yuanhao.ability_en: Held Hexi like a lion; created the Tangut script.
xixia-li-yuanhao.weakness_en: Murdered in his own palace; torn between war and peace.

q-qin-fu-jian.cry: 以吾之众旅，投鞭于江，足断其流。
q-qin-fu-jian.cry_en: With an army like mine, cast our whips into the Yangtze and its flow is dammed.
q-qin-fu-jian.ability_en: All the Hu made one; the north swiftly unified.
q-qin-fu-jian.weakness_en: One rout at the Fei; every tribe in revolt.

n-wei-xiaowen.cry: 国家兴自北土，文轨未一，此用武之地，非可文治。
n-wei-xiaowen.cry_en: Our state rose from the northern soil, script and gauge not yet one; this is a land for arms, not for civil rule.
n-wei-xiaowen.ability_en: Moved the capital to Luoyang; remade the state in Han ways.
n-wei-xiaowen.weakness_en: Southern campaigns drained the state; the Six Garrisons smoldered.

sui-wen.cry: 混一戎夏，方为天子之事。
sui-wen.cry_en: To make Rong and Xia one — that is the business of the Son of Heaven.
sui-wen.ability_en: Made the empire one again; built the Kaihuang institutions.
sui-wen.weakness_en: Suspicion and harsh scrutiny; one fatal choice of heir.

zhou-wu-zetian.cry_en: Sun and moon over the empty sky — that is Zhao.
zhou-wu-zetian.ability_en: Paved the road to Kaiyuan; enlarged the Zhenguan legacy.
zhou-wu-zetian.weakness_en: Cruel inquisitors wove their nets; her legitimacy ever in doubt.

tang-xian-zong.cry: 淮西既平，藩镇稍知朝廷。
tang-xian-zong.cry_en: With Huaixi pacified, the provinces at last learned there is a court.
tang-xian-zong.ability_en: Cut down Huaixi; the Yuanhe restoration.
tang-xian-zong.weakness_en: Elixirs and a sudden death; his policies died with him.

zhou-shi.cry: 十年开拓天下，十年养百姓，十年致太平。
zhou-shi.cry_en: Ten years to win the realm, ten years to nourish the people, ten years to bring peace.
zhou-shi.ability_en: Drilled and roused the army; campaigned south and north.
zhou-shi.weakness_en: Cut off in his prime; his life's work took another's name.

n-song-tai-zu.cry: 卧榻之侧，岂容他人鼾睡。
n-song-tai-zu.stand_name_en: A Cup of Wine, Arms Laid Down
n-song-tai-zu.cry_en: How could I let another man snore beside my own couch?
n-song-tai-zu.ability_en: A cup of wine, arms laid down; strong trunk, weak branches.

yuan-shi-zu.cry_en: When cart-track and script are one, then you see the Great Unity.
yuan-shi-zu.ability_en: Founded the province system; the yam relay spanned the realm.
yuan-shi-zu.weakness_en: Campaigns without end; Han law and steppe way forever split.

n-wei-taiwu.cry: 扫统万，平秦陇，翦辽海，荡河源。
n-wei-taiwu.stand_name_en: Iron Cavalry of the True Lord
n-wei-taiwu.stand_type_en: The Iron Hoof of the North
n-wei-taiwu.cry_en: Sweep Tongwan, level Qin and Long, shear the Liao shores, scour the river's source.
n-wei-taiwu.ability_en: Iron cavalry, decisive victory; the north made one.
n-wei-taiwu.weakness_en: The Buddhist faith stamped out in blood; slain by his own eunuch.
